about: The registry cases for madarch’s contract reader. Each case keeps the complete registry text and, for a refusal, the expected line and message. Kinds, prefixes, and link field names in these examples are neutral and are not the skill set’s vocabulary.

cases.name: the set-out stages and kinds
cases.text:
contract: 1
stages:
  - id: discovery
  - id: planning
  - id: design
  - id: delivery
  - id: validation
  - id: release
  - id: operations
kinds:
  - name: record
    prefix: REC
    folder: docs/records
    stage: discovery
    hint: capture an observation for later use
  - name: proposal
    prefix: PROP
    folder: docs/proposals
    stage: planning
    hint: describe a possible change
  - name: capability
    prefix: CAP
    folder: docs/capabilities
    stage: design
    hint: describe a system ability
  - name: outcome
    prefix: OUT
    folder: docs/outcomes
    stage: validation
    hint: record a measured result

cases.name: manifest expectations and configurable reader sources

contract: 1

    expected:
      - interview
kinds:

    prefix: IQ
    folder: docs/inquiries
    stage: explore

    questions:
      identityPrefix: ASK
      titleSeparator: ':'
      promptSection: Unknown
      answerSection: Resolution
      answererField: Steward
      concernsField: Affects
      notApplicablePrefix: 'Out of scope:'
